purpose: Derive a minimal, outcome-blind breeding-landform atlas before adding terrain, snow, melt, ecosystem or demographic-response variables.

activation_gate.required: Gate 1A passes its original 95% land-match / <=5% multiple-match rule

units.site_unit: distinct APBP site_id among the frozen Pygoscelis candidate set
units.land_polygon_source: SCAR ADD v7.12 FeatureServer land polygon assigned under Gate 1A

continental_reference.rule: Query the SCAR ADD land layer at the South Pole (0 E, 90 S). Gate 1B requires exactly one intersecting land polygon; its object ID is the continental reference polygon.
continental_reference.failure_rule: If zero or multiple land polygons intersect the South Pole, do not substitute an area threshold or named polygon; Gate 1B fails pending source review.

site_type.offshore_island: assigned land object ID differs from the continental reference object ID
site_type.continental_or_peninsular: assigned land object ID equals the continental reference object ID
site_type.unresolved: Gate 1A does not yield exactly one assigned polygon at the selected tolerance

primary_traits.name: land_polygon_area_m2
primary_traits.definition: Area of the assigned SCAR ADD land polygon in the native EPSG:3031 metric CRS; validate against server Shape__Area before release.

primary_traits.name: offshore_island
primary_traits.definition: Binary site-type classification from the continental-reference rule.

primary_traits.name: distance_to_continental_land_m
primary_traits.definition: Minimum EPSG:3031 polygon-to-polygon distance between the assigned offshore-island polygon and the continental reference polygon; zero for continental/peninsular sites.

primary_traits.name: nearest_candidate_penguin_site_distance_m
primary_traits.definition: Minimum EPSG:3031 point-to-point distance from the APBP site coordinate to any other distinct candidate APBP site, irrespective of species.

quality_checks.assigned_polygon_geometry: Fetch each assigned polygon individually from the FeatureServer in native EPSG:3031; do not reuse the failed continent-scale bulk-geometry transport.
area: positive finite area for every resolved polygon
locally computed polygon area and server Shape__Area agree within 1% where Shape__Area is available
classification: Torgersen Island, Penguin Island and Franklin Island East must classify as offshore islands if present in the candidate set
a known continental/peninsular candidate site must classify as continental_or_peninsular; the site is selected before demographic outcomes are opened
quality_checks.isolation: offshore-island distances must be positive and continental/peninsular distances must equal zero
quality_checks.nearest_site: all distances positive for distinct coordinates; exact coordinate duplicates are reported rather than jittered

next_gate: Gate 1C adds habitat-option and terrain traits only after Gate 1B geometry is frozen and audited.
